_note:
Pages of the Annales' hourly CLOUD-FORM table: a date and seven pairs of (hour, cloud-form codes), fifteen cells, which is the same shape and the same count as the hourly WIND table. The cell-count assignment sent them to rio-1883-vento until wrb.qc.looks_like_cloud_forms was written.

This project has no profile for them, so they are recorded here rather than read under a layout that is not theirs. The codes are C cirrus, K cumulus, N nimbus, S stratus, combining with hyphens (C-K cirro-cumulus) and with commas when an interval showed more than one form.

They are a real observation series - cloud type seven times a day for a month - and writing the profile is a small job whenever someone wants it.
